metaTitle: Invoice Template Australia: ATO Tax & 10% GST Compliant
metaDescription: ATO-compliant invoice template for Australia. Calculate 10% GST automatically, include your ABN, and download clean, watermark-free tax invoices in PDF.
intro: Create ATO-compliant Australian tax invoices with 10% GST calculations and your ABN in seconds.

howTo.title: How to Create an Australian Tax Invoice
howTo.subtitle: Follow these three steps to issue a valid tax invoice under Australian tax law.

steps.title: Add Your Business Name and ABN
steps.description: Enter your legal or trading name and your 11-digit Australian Business Number (ABN). The document must display the words 'Tax invoice' at the top.
steps.tip: Only businesses registered for GST may issue a document titled 'Tax invoice'.

steps.title: List Items and Client Information
steps.description: Describe each good or service clearly. If the sale is $1,000 or more (including GST), you must also include the buyer's name or ABN.
steps.tip: State whether prices include GST or add 10% GST to the taxable subtotal.

steps.title: Review the GST Amount and Download
steps.description: Check that the 10% GST amount is clearly visible. Download your free PDF or print a copy for your Business Activity Statement (BAS) records.
steps.tip: The ATO requires businesses to keep issued tax invoices for at least five years [Verify with official source: ATO record retention rules].

whatItMustContain.title: What an Australian Tax Invoice Must Contain
whatItMustContain.subtitle: The Australian Taxation Office (ATO) requires seven elements for a valid tax invoice.
whatItMustContain.disclaimer: General information, not legal or tax advice. Check your local rules.

items.title: The Words 'Tax invoice'
items.description: The title must state 'Tax invoice'. Do not use this title if your business is not registered for GST.

items.title: Seller Identity and ABN
items.description: Your registered business name or trading name, plus your active 11-digit Australian Business Number (ABN).

items.title: Date of Issue
items.description: The date you issue the invoice. This sets the tax period for your quarterly or monthly BAS return.

items.title: Buyer Identity (Sales of $1,000+)
items.description: If the total is $1,000 or more, you must include the buyer's name, trading name, address, or ABN [Verify with official source: ATO $1,000 threshold].

items.title: Clear Item Descriptions
items.description: A clear description of the goods or services supplied, including unit quantities where applicable.

items.title: GST Amount Shown Clearly
items.description: Show the 10% GST amount separately, or state 'Total price includes GST' when every item includes GST [Verify with official source: ATO GST display rules].

faq.title: Australian Tax Invoicing FAQs
faq.subtitle: Direct answers to common questions about Australian GST and tax invoicing.

items.question: When must an Australian business register for GST?
items.answer: You must register for GST when your business turnover reaches or is expected to reach $75,000 AUD per year ($150,000 for non-profit bodies). Taxi and ride-share drivers must register regardless of turnover [Verify with official source: ATO GST registration threshold].

items.question: Can I issue a tax invoice if I am not registered for GST?
items.answer: No. If you are not registered for GST, you cannot charge GST and your document must not include the words 'Tax invoice'. Issue a regular invoice showing the total amount without GST.

items.question: How do I calculate GST from a GST-inclusive total?
items.answer: Divide the total GST-inclusive amount by 11. For example, if a bill is $1,100 including GST, the GST portion is $100 ($1,100 divided by 11 = $100).

items.question: How long do I need to keep tax invoices in Australia?
items.answer: The ATO requires businesses to keep records of all sales and purchases for at least five years from the date you lodge your tax return [Verify with official source: ATO record-keeping timeline].
